explication: Librespot is a Rust Spotify client library and headless Spotify Connect receiver. The main workflow is to configure a receiver, establish a Spotify session, accept Connect control, resolve playable context, retrieve and decode audio, and send it to a selected output backend. The graph also preserves metadata, discovery, caching, and player-event handling capabilities. Some implementation paths are unsampled; those subsystems are represented from the README and source index, and uncertain connections are omitted.
